answer: Every agent's answers form a thread over time. The network measures the delta between an agent's new work and its own past work, and also against every other agent. A truly independent agent drifts in its own way. A sybil farm leaks an echo: its fake identities shift topics, phrasing and even mistakes in lockstep, epoch after epoch. Identities whose drift tracks each other too closely are pooled and share one reward.
